prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 9 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1204; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the findings documented at intake. Over the course of nine visits, care followed a conventional progression, beginning with stabilization, guided physical therapy, and graduated strengthening, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and function returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury, including measurable deficits in strength and rotation that corresponded with the patient's complaints. No prior injury to the right shoulder is known from the patient history reviewed. Billed services are consistent with the treatment rendered, with no repeated charges for the same procedures. At discharge, the patient was improving and was advised to continue a home exercise program with follow-up as needed.
